slides.text: Five questions before any tool talks to your clients
slides.voiceover_text: Five questions every owner should ask before letting any tool speak to clients. Skip these, regret them later.

slides.text: Where does client data go? Get it in writing
slides.voiceover_text: One. Where does client data go? Where's it stored? Who has access? Get the answer in writing. If the vendor's vague, walk away.

slides.text: What can't it say? Write the no-go list
slides.voiceover_text: Two. What's it never allowed to say? Prices it doesn't know. Promises about outcomes. Deadlines you haven't approved. Write the list. Test it.

slides.text: Where's the kill switch and who flips it?
slides.voiceover_text: Three. Where's the kill switch? Who in your firm can take it offline in five minutes if something goes wrong? Pick the person. Test it once.

slides.text: Data. Boundaries. Kill switch. In writing.
slides.voiceover_text: Data path. Hard boundaries. A kill switch. Get all three in writing before anything goes live.
